summary: The open AI model repository and developer inference ecosystem has consolidated around Hugging Face as the dominant hub with over 2.2 million models and 2.2 billion downloads, while a growing set of specialized inference platforms like Together AI, Fireworks AI, and SiliconFlow compete on speed and cost for API access to open-weight models. The ecosystem is highly concentrated, with the top 200 models accounting for nearly half of all downloads, and leading families like Llama (476M cumulative downloads), DeepSeek (128.2M), and Mistral (124.3M) driving the majority of usage. Developers in 2026 can choose between cloud-hosted inference APIs, local desktop runners like Ollama and LM Studio, or self-hosted GPU serving via vLLM, giving the ecosystem a layered structure from hobbyist to production scale.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: Central open-source hub for discovering, sharing, and deploying machine learning models, datasets, and demo applications (Spaces)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public models and limited inference; Pro at $9/month; Enterprise Hub from $20/user/month; pay-per-use Inference Endpoints billed by compute hour
features: Largest open model repository with 2.2 billion total downloads
Model cards, version control, and dataset hosting
Spaces for interactive Gradio and Streamlit demos
Inference Providers tier routing to partners like Together AI and Fireworks AI
Fine-tuning and AutoTrain tools
Private model hosting and access control for teams
Active community leaderboards and evaluations
platforms.best_for: Researchers, open-source contributors, and teams needing a one-stop hub for model discovery, versioning, and community collaboration

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: Local model runner that lets developers download and serve open-weight LLMs on their own hardware via a simple CLI and REST API
platforms.model_count: 500+ curated models in its library (Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, Gemma, Phi, and more)
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source; hardware costs only
features: One-command model pull and run (e.g. ollama run llama3)
OpenAI-compatible REST API for easy app integration
GPU acceleration on Apple Silicon, NVIDIA, and AMD
Model quantization support for running large models on consumer hardware
Modelfile system for custom system prompts and parameter tuning
Integrates with Open WebUI, LangChain, and other frameworks
Completely offline and private by design
platforms.best_for: Developers and power users who want fast, private, offline LLM inference on their own Mac, Linux, or Windows machine without cloud costs

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: Cloud API platform for running open-source AI models on demand, covering language, image, video, and audio models without infrastructure management
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second of compute time; no upfront cost; prices vary by hardware (e.g. ~$0.0014/sec on Nvidia T4, ~$0.0055/sec on A100); free tier credits for new users
features: Simplest API for 50,000+ models including Stable Diffusion, Flux, Llama, and Whisper
Automatic scaling with no cold-start management required
Deployments feature for pinning model versions in production
Fine-tuning support for image and language models
Webhooks and async prediction support
Python, Node.js, and HTTP client libraries
Community model sharing and versioning
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups who want the simplest possible API to prototype and ship apps using open-source models without managing GPUs

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: High-performance, low-cost cloud inference platform for open-weight LLMs with an OpenAI-compatible API, plus fine-tuning and training capabilities
platforms.model_count: 100+ leading open-weight models including Llama 3, DeepSeek, Mistral, Qwen, and DBRX
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token; among the lowest prices in the market (e.g. Llama 3.1 8B at ~$0.10/M input tokens); free $25 credit on signup; volume discounts available
features: OpenAI-compatible API for drop-in replacement in existing apps
Among the fastest inference speeds for open-weight models
Dedicated endpoints for consistent latency in production
Full fine-tuning and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) pipeline
Custom model deployment on Together's GPU cloud
Supports function calling and JSON mode
Routed through Hugging Face Inference Providers tier
platforms.best_for: Developers and teams needing low-cost, high-throughput LLM inference in production with an easy migration path from OpenAI

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: Production-grade inference platform optimized for speed and reliability on open-weight language and multimodal models, targeting enterprise developers
platforms.model_count: 50+ curated production-ready models including Llama, Mixtral, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Firefunction
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token; competitive with Together AI (e.g. Llama 3.1 8B at ~$0.10/M input tokens); free tier available; serverless and dedicated deployment options
features: Industry-leading inference latency with FireAttention optimization engine
OpenAI-compatible chat completions and embeddings API
Function calling and structured JSON output support
Compound AI system support for multi-model workflows
Fine-tuned model hosting and serving
Dedicated GPU deployments for reserved capacity
SOC 2 Type II compliance for enterprise security
platforms.best_for: Production engineering teams and enterprises that prioritize latency, reliability, and compliance when serving open-weight models at scale

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: All-in-one AI model hosting and high-performance inference platform offering some of the best price-to-performance ratios for open-weight model deployment
platforms.model_count: 100+ open-weight models including DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen, FLUX, and Stable Diffusion
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token with highly competitive rates; free tier with generous credits; noted as best value option in 2026 for combined hosting and inference
features: Ranked best value AI model hosting platform for 2026
Faster-than-average inference speeds for cost tier
Support for both LLM and image generation models
OpenAI-compatible API
Batch inference for cost-effective high-volume workloads
Model hosting and private deployment options
Strong support for Chinese-origin models like DeepSeek and Qwen
platforms.best_for: Cost-conscious developers and teams needing high-throughput inference for open-weight models, especially those working with DeepSeek or Qwen model families

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: Unified inference API aggregator that routes requests to the cheapest or fastest available provider across dozens of models and backends
platforms.model_count: 300+ models from providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Mistral, Google, and open-source deployments
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token at provider cost with a small routing markup; free models available; no subscription required
features: Single API key for access to 300+ models across all major providers
Automatic fallback and load balancing across providers
Cost and latency comparison across providers in real time
OpenAI-compatible API format
Model routing by price, speed, or context length
Usage dashboard with per-model spend tracking
Support for open-weight and proprietary models in one endpoint
platforms.best_for: Developers who want maximum model flexibility and lowest cost through intelligent routing without managing multiple provider API keys

platforms.name: DeepInfra
platforms.purpose: Serverless inference API for open-source LLMs, embedding models, and speech models with a focus on low pricing and broad model coverage
platforms.model_count: 200+ open-weight models including Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, Whisper, and embedding models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token; among the lowest prices available (e.g. Llama 3.1 8B at ~$0.06/M tokens); free tier for low-volume usage
features: Very competitive per-token pricing for cost-sensitive workloads
Covers LLMs, embedding, text-to-speech, and speech-to-text models
OpenAI-compatible REST API
Automatic scaling with no cold starts on popular models
Private model deployment option
Simple Python and HTTP client integration
Listed as a recommended Hugging Face Inference Providers alternative
platforms.best_for: Budget-focused developers and researchers needing broad model access including embeddings and speech at the lowest possible per-token cost

platforms.name: Baseten
platforms.purpose: Production inference platform for deploying custom and open-weight models as scalable, low-latency API endpoints with fine-grained infrastructure control
platforms.model_count: Supports deployment of any open-weight or custom model; pre-built Truss templates for 50+ popular models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-compute-second on GPU instances; minimum spend applies for dedicated deployments; free trial credits available
features: Truss open-source framework for packaging any model as an API
Fast cold-start architecture with model caching
Autoscaling from zero to hundreds of replicas
Custom preprocessing and postprocessing in Python
Streaming responses and async inference support
Fine-grained GPU selection (A10G, A100, H100)
Webhook and queue-based batch inference
platforms.best_for: ML engineers who need to deploy custom fine-tuned or proprietary models as production APIs with full control over the serving stack

platforms.name: RunPod
platforms.purpose: GPU cloud marketplace for renting raw GPU compute to run inference, fine-tuning, or any custom workload via Pods or Serverless endpoints
platforms.model_count: Not a model hub; supports any model the user brings; community templates for 100+ popular models
platforms.pricing: Spot and on-demand GPU rental from ~$0.20/hr for RTX 3080 to ~$2.49/hr for H100; serverless billing per compute second
features: Wide GPU selection including H100, A100, RTX 4090 at competitive rates
Persistent and temporary pod storage
Serverless GPU endpoints that scale to zero when idle
Community templates for quick deployment of Stable Diffusion, Llama, and others
SSH and Jupyter access for full control
Network volumes for shared storage across pods
Global data centers for low-latency deployment
platforms.best_for: Developers and researchers who need raw GPU access for custom workloads, large-scale fine-tuning, or running models not available on managed platforms

platforms.name: LM Studio
platforms.purpose: Desktop application for discovering, downloading, and running open-weight LLMs locally with a polished GUI and built-in local inference server
platforms.model_count: Browses and downloads from Hugging Face; access to thousands of GGUF-format quantized models
platforms.pricing: Free for local use; no cloud costs
features: GUI-based model discovery and download from Hugging Face
Built-in chat interface for local model testing
Local OpenAI-compatible server for app integration
GGUF quantization support for running large models on consumer hardware
GPU acceleration on Apple Silicon, NVIDIA, and AMD
Model comparison and conversation history
Completely offline and private
platforms.best_for: Non-technical users and developers who want a polished desktop experience for running open-weight models locally without using the command line

platforms.name: vLLM
platforms.purpose: High-throughput, memory-efficient open-source inference engine for self-hosted LLM serving on GPU infrastructure
platforms.model_count: Supports any Hugging Face-compatible model; optimized for Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, Qwen, and 50+ architectures
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source; infrastructure costs only
features: PagedAttention algorithm for near-optimal GPU memory utilization
Continuous batching for maximizing throughput under concurrent load
OpenAI-compatible server API out of the box
Support for tensor parallelism across multiple GPUs
Speculative decoding for faster generation
AWQ and GPTQ quantization support
Widely used as the backend for managed inference platforms
platforms.best_for: ML infrastructure engineers deploying high-throughput LLM serving on their own GPU clusters or cloud VMs who need maximum performance
